feature_contract.goal: Avoid an inset or double-letterboxed original title/menu/selector image when its native D3DX matrix already underwent viewport containment and is subsequently copied into the custom-sprite quad renderer.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Exact game D3DX matrix result and consumer only, R84 mainline; preserve uncached quad, Vanilla, HUD, GOAL, SkyGlow, world, input/FFB, R26_SAFE rollback and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original frontend D3DXMatrixTransformation2D scales or translates authored source with live viewport containment.
Native custom SPRARGS2 consumes the exact copied D3DX matrix and otherwise would apply a second 4:3 output map.
Same-thread bounded full-matrix plus mode/scaling/viewport provenance switches only matching physical pixel sprites to an identity quad map; no classification changes in R84 eye or host.
subcomponents: Record successful transformed full/partial/pivoted native D3DX source matrices at the original hook.
Recognize only exact copied source matrices in the custom-quad physical vertex producer, suppress duplicate contain and preserve all existing negative fallbacks.
Extend portable C++ positive and foreign-mode/reset/invalid/eviction regressions; require final exact SHA Windows x86 game+x64 host/package and Domain/affected inspections.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original D3DX menu matrix to custom quad vertex positions
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: An exact already-contained native menu/selector matrix is mapped to physical output pixels once, avoiding a second inset 4:3 scaling.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original unmapped, other-mode, reset-stale and invalid game matrices
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Only full exact source provenance admits suppression; all other quad, gameplay HUD and F11 paths retain original pixel transforms.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 Active Windows game/OpenXR host/package and Domain
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All required GitHub Actions gates pass for final non-skipped result SHA; Quest3 optical test is independently UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Two real hooks compose frontend containment: D3DXMatrixTransformation2D modifies the original matrix; draw_sprite_custom_matrix_mid maps the matrix-transformed vertices again by BuildPixelMap.
diagnosis.root_cause: No positive source-matrix provenance was shared between matrix producer and custom-quad consumer, permitting duplicate containment on a copied transformed menu matrix.
alternatives_rejected: Do not disable all game pixel mapping, change VR optical coverage, crop off car-selection sides or promote gameplay HUD to menu.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Native full/partial/pivoted D3DX output fingerprinted by exact 16-float same-thread mode/viewport matrix provenance, which prevents a second custom sprite quad containment only on matches.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable native matrix ledger positive/other-mode/reset/foreign/nonfinite/eviction assertions and two existing source verifiers extended to reject conditional fallback bypass mutants. All required exact-SHA GitHub Windows gates PASS.
diagnosis.runtime_limit: No actual Quest3/VDXR headset was connected; optical effect and FPS remain unverified.

ci_evidence.summary: Exact non-skipped SHA passed Windows DX9Ex R84 game/R26_SAFE/OpenXR host/package, full-chain-compile, HUD Inspector, Domain Isolation and MSVC Source Impact. Initial source verifier failures were repaired under same TASK_ID, not separately scored.

next_action: NEED_HMD_TEST only for user-visible optical acceptance; source build and exact SHA CI verified. Advance controller to next independent DX9Ex feature rather than redo C6.
